programme.title: Hitler and I: Reflections on Evil
programme.desc: An in-depth, behind-the-scenes exploration of the making of the miniseries "Hitler: The Rise of Evil."

programme.title: Secret War: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists
programme.desc: Fitzroy Maclean, an MP and WWII spy, supported Tito's Communist partisans in Yugoslavia against the Germans, forging a lasting friendship and honored at Tito's funeral post-war.
programme.sub-title: The Aristocrat and the Balkan Communists

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Hitler's Biggest Blunder
programme.desc: Hitler rules Europe triumphantly, hailed as a hero in Germany. Hitler invades the Soviet Union, promising swift victory over communism, but progress stalls. As Germany faces setbacks, Hitler retreats to his bunker in Poland, increasingly reliant on drugs.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Grand Mufti
programme.desc: The controversy surrounding Mohammad Amin al-Husayni, stems from his Nazi collaboration. He recruited Bosnian Muslims and advocated for a Palestinian homeland with Nazi help. His diaries reveal awareness of the Holocaust and anti-Semitic sentiments.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Devil's Due
programme.desc: During WWII, Greek Prime Ministers Tsolakoglou, Logothetopoulos, and Rallis collaborated with Nazi occupiers, imposing fees that caused a famine.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Becoming Respectable
programme.desc: In 1924, Hitler is convicted for High Treason after the failed Nazi power grab. In prison, he writes Mein Kampf, articulating his anti-Semitic and expansionist beliefs. Upon release, Hitler rebrands the Nazi Party.

programme.title: Weapons That Changed the World
programme.desc: Tanks have transformed warfare since their debut a century ago. Host Wil Willis traces their evolution from World War One breakthroughs to modern marvels like the M1 Abrams, the world's most powerful Main Battle Tank.

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: Italy: The Sulmona Trail
programme.desc: Monty follows the route taken by prisoner of war Len Harley, who spent months on the run before braving snow, ice, and Nazi patrols to escape over the mountains of the Majella in Italy.

programme.title: Secret War: Christine Granville
programme.desc: Christine Granville, aka Krystyna Skarbek, a brave SOE agent, secured the release of captured comrades from the Gestapo before Operation Dragoon, earning the George Medal.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler
programme.desc: In Hitler’s Germany, those with Jewish ancestry faced harsh Nuremberg Laws. Full Jews faced death; Mischlinge endured discrimination, job bans. Some, like Helmut Schmidt, unaware of heritage, found protectors like Milch in high places.
programme.sub-title: The Jews Who Fought for Hitler

programme.title: WWII's The Great Escapes: The Freedom Trails: France and Spain: The Pyrenees
programme.desc: Monty treks one of the toughest and most famous freedom trails out of Nazi controlled France, taking him through the valleys and high ridges of the Pyrenees mountains and into Spain.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: In Power
programme.desc: Adolf Hitler's secret agenda is to rid Germany of Jews. By 1938, after creating work schemes and rearming, he orchestrates "The Night of Broken Glass," burning 1,000 synagogues and killing 91 Jews, preparing for further aggression.

programme.title: Nazi Collaborators: Traitor-in-Chief
programme.desc: Pierre Laval, once celebrated and later reviled, faced execution in 1945 for collaboration with the Nazis during Vichy France. Originally a socialist and pacifist, he fell into collaboration for power and to navigate the horrors of occupation.

programme.title: Hitler Uncovering His Fatal Obsession: Barbarossa Unleashed 1941
programme.desc: E1 begins with a brief examination of the rationale of hatred projected by Hitler onto the Soviet-Slavic-Jewish world. Then it leaps forward, to see Hitler initiate an invasion of the USSR.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: Aftermath
programme.desc: In WWII's final months, Allies discover Nazi death camps, prompting a sweeping denazification of Germany post-war. Nuremberg trials convict top Nazis. Former Nazis are employed by the West in the Cold War struggle against the Soviet Union.

programme.title: The Rise of the Nazi Party: End Game
programme.desc: In January 1945, Nazi Germany faces defeat as Allied armies close in. Hitler, aged 55 and in poor health, remains defiant in his Berlin bunker. On April 30th, 1945, Hitler commits suicide, and days later, Germany surrenders, ending World War II.

programme.title: The Real Oppenheimer SV
programme.desc: År 1945 fördes världen in i atomåldern. Med sin roll som bombens fader befäst blev Oppenheimer alltmer oroad över den potentiella fara som vetenskapliga uppfinningar kunde utgöra för mänskligheten.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2017: Twice Upon a Time
programme.desc: Den tolfte Doktorn måste konfrontera sitt förflutna för att avgöra sin framtid.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2005: The Christmas Invasion
programme.desc: Medan den nyligen regenererade Doktorn ligger i koma, anländer Sycorax.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2006: The Runaway Bride
programme.desc: Doktorn får en ny följeslagare och de avslöjar en uråldrig utomjordisk plan.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2007: Voyage of the Damned
programme.desc: När katastrofen drabbar RMS Titanic upptäcker doktorn ett hot mot hela mänskligheten.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2008: The Next Doctor
programme.desc: När Doktorn träffar en annan doktor måste de två slå sig ihop för att stoppa CyberKing.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2009: The End of Time Part 1
programme.desc: Det är julafton och Doktorn återförenas med Wilf, och en gammal fiende återvänder.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2009: The End of Time Part 1
programme.desc: Doktorns liv lider mot sitt slut när Mästarens seger utlöser den värsta möjliga terrorn.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2010: A Christmas Carol
programme.desc: Amy och Rory är instängda ombord på ett kraschande rymdskepp i denna julspecial.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Christmas Special 2011: The Doctor, the Widow and the Wardrobe
programme.desc: Doktorn blir vän med familjen Arwell från det krigshärjade Storbritannien och snart väntar faran.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Christmas Special 2012: The Snowmen
programme.desc: Doktorn och hans nya följeslagare Clara möter den lömske doktor Simeon och en armé av snögubbar.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2013: The Time of the Doctor
programme.desc: Den elfte Doktorn tar kontroll över TARDIS för sista gången.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2014: Last Christmas
programme.desc: Doktorn och Clara är fångade på en arktisk bas och deras enda hopp är jultomten!

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2015: The Husbands Of River Song
programme.desc: Doktorn rekryteras av River Song och blir inblandad i en jakt genom galaxen.

programme.title: Doctor Who: Special: Christmas 2016: The Return of Doctor Mysterio
programme.desc: Doktorn slår sig ihop med en superhjälte för att rädda New York från ett dödligt utomjordiskt hot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls arrive in Rio and excitedly explore the luxurious villa they will be staying in. On a rare day off, they are driven to Ipanema to play beach volleyball with local guys, and in the evening, they are joined for dinner by Lisa.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The top three girls take a cable car to Sugar Loaf Mountain to learn Samba dancing.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Aptitude and Natural Talent
programme.desc: All 14 girls are interviewed by the press where they are asked why they want to win. The models pair up and pick each partners best and worst features. The girls receive news about their first photoshoot and later find out it's a topless shoot in pairs.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Poise and Composure
programme.desc: The girls get a crash course in dance with top choreographer Supple and a runway lesson from top fashionista Jeanette. The winners get to take part in a fashion show featuring the work of top designer Scottee - whose dresses are all made out of paper.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Style and Presentation
programme.desc: The girls find out they're getting makeovers in a Lisa Mail. This weeks challenge is a bucking bronco advertisement for the cheesy "Britain's Next Top Model Hairspray". In this weeks photoshoot they have the added element of working with a small dog.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Character and Personality
programme.desc: The girls took part in a challenge for Jai Kudo glasses. At the photoshoot the models are greeted by Gerry Deveaux and Giorgio Guidotti, of Italian fashion house, Primarni for a shoot for the latest collection by SportMax one of Max Mara's labels.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Exhibition and Spectacle
programme.desc: The girls meet with TV star, June Sarpong to learn interview skills and are judged by undercover magazine journalists. The claws are out as the girls critique each other during the challenge. Tension in the house builds.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Drama and Performance
programme.desc: This week the girls learn some new choreography with Supple and in the photoshoot the girls are told they are to pose for an album cover. Lisa Snowdon treats everyone to cocktails with The Bar Wizards -finalists on last years Britain's Got Talent.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Intelligence and Originality
programme.desc: The models face an acting challenge which includes a steamy kissing scene with guest actor Guy Burnet. The photoshoot this week is a couture shot where each girl had to portray a different emotion.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Imagination and Creativity
programme.desc: The girls pose as different types of mannequines for their photoshoot.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Stamina and Endurance
programme.desc: The girls are put through a series of circus acts and asked to model on plinths in London's streets. The girls also pose for beauty shots in Zandra Rhodes dresses in the style of sporting events.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Beauty and Cover Girl
programme.desc: The girls start the week by attending a casting session with Sadie Frost and Jemima French. They meet up with Caroline Barnes and Sophie Beresiner for a beauty editorial and the photoshoot is for the cover of Company Magazine.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Semi-Finals
programme.desc: In the penulimate episode of Cycle 4, the girls arive in South Africa and they participate in an African themed photoshoot. In the end one girl is sent home to the UK.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model: Finals
programme.desc: In the finale the girls do one last photoshoot with animals in the South African bush. Then, after one girl is eliminated, the girls participate in an African runway show and 'Britain's Next Top Model' is crowned.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The contestants arrive at the house with a champagne reception greeted by host Lisa. They complete an assault course and a catwalk challenge featuring clothing by Ed Hardy. The photo challenge sees the remaining girls in an army inspired shoot with Huggy.
programme.sub-title: The Girls Go To Boot Camp

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: This weeks challenge is to film an advert on the Millennium bridge wearing Elizabeth Emanuel bridal wear. The photoshoot challenge asks the girls to pose naked in a bath of water filled with mangos for Simple Cosmetics.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls excitedly receive their long awaited makeovers. The challenge involves the girls performing a dance routine in groups of four at London's Movida nightclub.

programme.title: Britain's Next Top Model
programme.desc: The girls meet 'rock royalty' Jo Wood who challenges them to inspire teenagers. They're interviewed by Johnny Vaughan at Capital FM and the photo shoot has the girls posing for adverts highlighting issues raised by charities and campaigns

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har köpt och sålt över 100 bilar under 13 års tid och hans tomt är full av olika fordon. Han har en bra lön, men spenderar desto mer, och när kontot ekar tomt handlas det på kredit.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Else har skatteskulder och riskerar att bli av med sitt hus. De höga elpriserna och Elses överdrivna konsumtion av kaffe, mat och mobilspel tar över hennes budget och får framtiden att se mörk ut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Sverre och experterna blir chockade då ett brev dyker upp om att Sverres hus måste säljas. Sverre har valt festandet före att bygga klart sitt hus, och har använt fakturor för att tända brasor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Daniel dricker 3 liter läsk om dagen och gamla lån har hindrat honom och Mona från att bilda familj. Mona tror att Daniel spenderat små summor på vadslagning men det visar sig handla om mer pengar.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2506
programme.desc: Ulrik har tagit stora lån för att etablera sig med familjen men har tappat kontrollen och får en otrevlig överraskning när experterna anländer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Madeleine älskar inredning och hennes garderob är full av nyinköpta kläder. När Madeleine vill ha något nytt så köper hon det. Hon lever över sina tillgångar och de dyra lånen hopar sig.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Robin slösar bort alla sina pengar på dyra hobbies. Han har precis gjort slut med Madeleine från förra avsnittet, och med hennes skyhöga skulder och överdrivna utgifter är hans nya liv svårt.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Bibbi är sjuksköterska och ska snart gå i pension, men med sina skulder kommer hon inte att kunna gå i pension vid 67 års ålder. Hennes hus är fullt av kläder, smycken och tomma champagneflaskor. Kommer hon att kunna ändra sin livsstil?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Roy Erik köper och säljer klockor varannan vecka och experterna har aldrig sett ett sådant slöseri. Han köper på impuls och säljer med förlust. Med sin höga skuld kommer han aldrig att kunna köpa ett eget hus.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Helene har en bra inkomst, men i stället för att lägga undan pengar shoppar hon. Hon lägger 13.000 norska kronor i månaden bara på nätshopping och drömmen om att köpa ett eget hus känns avlägsen.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Arild blandar ihop sin privatekonomi med sitt företag och har därför tappat kontrollen. Han har skulder på långt över en miljon kronor. Arild är en skicklig tatuerare, men hur kan han rädda sin ekonomi?

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Hilde slösar bort sin lön som lastbilschaufför på sitt bilintresse. Hon struntar i räkningarna, kylskåpet är tomt, elen är på väg att stängas av och skulderna växer.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Ellinor har sålt sitt hus och är på väg att starta om sitt liv. Trots en bra inkomst har hon det kämpigt. Experterna följer med henne under flyttprocessen och blir chockade över hur mycket pengar som läggs på onödiga inköp.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2501
programme.desc: Ørjan har köpt och sålt över 100 bilar under 13 års tid och hans tomt är full av olika fordon. Han har en bra lön, men spenderar desto mer, och när kontot ekar tomt handlas det på kredit.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2502
programme.desc: Else har skatteskulder och riskerar att bli av med sitt hus. De höga elpriserna och Elses överdrivna konsumtion av kaffe, mat och mobilspel tar över hennes budget och får framtiden att se mörk ut.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2503
programme.desc: Odins liv vändes på sin kant när han sjuk i cancer, och nu hindrar skulderna från tiden innan och under sjukdomen honom från att bygga det liv han vill ha.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge
programme.desc: Sverre och experterna blir chockade då ett brev dyker upp om att Sverres hus måste säljas. Sverre har valt festandet före att bygga klart sitt hus, och har använt fakturor för att tända brasor.

programme.title: Lyxfällan Norge: Avsnitt 2505
programme.desc: Daniel dricker 3 liter läsk om dagen och gamla lån har hindrat honom och Mona från att bilda familj. Mona tror att Daniel spenderat små summor på vadslagning men det visar sig handla om mer pengar.

programme.title: Muscle Cars of Texas
programme.desc: Vinnie and the team at Muscle Cars of Texas take you on a tour of what is happening in the shop. Replacing the front end of a 64 Corvette resto mod. Painting racing stripes on a 67 442 convertible. A yellow Camaro underneath the hood of this car.

programme.title: FantomWorks
programme.desc: Dan's team take on the restorations of a 1966 Volkswagen Beetle and a 1976 TR6 convertible. The TR6 looks bad, but Dan sees hidden potential for it to become a rare 'survivor' car that still has its original paint and fixtures.

programme.title: FantomWorks

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: Det närmar sig slutet, och det ska fattas stora beslut som skakar om huset.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: De tre finalparen måste visa sig starkast om de ska vinna 'Dating Naked'. Men 50 000 pund står på spel. Kan deras rätta färger visa sig?

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: I jakten på kärleken klär tio singlar av sig i en vågad dejtingutmaning. Utan kläder lär de känna varandra innan deras kontakt prövas.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: Den första nakna nybörjaren spiller ingen tid. Vissa relationer går framåt medan andra går bakåt, och det blir spänt innan en dejtare dumpas för gott.

programme.title: Dating Naked UK
programme.desc: Efter den första dumpningen letar dejtarna sina kontakter. Visa relationer bryts, och nya kan spira. En lek får en dejtare att ångra sig, och tiden rinner ut för en av tjejerna.

programme.desc: Tom and Diana's investigation into a series of gruesome murders leads them to uncover another conspiracy within the government. At the 4400 Center, Shawn receives a gift from another returnee that allows him to see his future.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Kate hunts down Scott in Bethel before he can exact revenge. In Houston, Richie & Santanico find themselves in the flesh trade, while Seth tries to get back in Uncle Eddie's good graces.
programme.sub-title: The Best Little Horror House in Texas

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Richie & Seth call a truce & work together to find Malvado's headquarters. Carlos abducts Santanico & claims her for himself. Kate enlists Freddie's help as she attempts to save her brother.

programme.title: From Dusk Till Dawn: The Series
programme.desc: Following the trail of the mass grave, Freddie & Kate uncover an epic secret & find themselves trapped in the cellar of Oculto, one of the more reclusive & dangerous Lords of the Night.

programme.title: The Millers: Plus One
programme.desc: Nathan's excitement at scoring a ticket for himself and a guest to a dinner with President Obama turns to dread when he has to pick one of his family members to be his "plus one."

programme.title: The Millers: Walk-n-Wave
programme.desc: Worried that his mother has made him feel like he's better than other people, Nathan befriends a hopeless co-worker, Doug, who turns out to be a social outcast and more than Nathan knows how to handle.

programme.title: The Millers: Cancellation Fee
programme.desc: Nathan tries to date his mother's dentist in secret after Carol adds her to the Miller Family Blacklist for charging her a $75 cancellation fee for being late to her appointment.

programme.title: The Millers: 72
programme.desc: When Tom proudly tells the family he's dating a much younger woman, Nathan goes undercover to spy on him and make sure his father isn't being scammed by a gold digger.

programme.title: The Millers: Sex Ed Dolan
programme.desc: Nathan introduces his boss, Ed Dolan, to Tom in hopes they'll hit it off and hang out together, but surprisingly, Dolan only has eyes for Carol. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Mother's Day
programme.desc: Carol has the worst Mother's Day ever when Nathan forgets to get her a present.

programme.title: The Millers: Movin' Out (Carol's Song)
programme.desc: Carol begins her search for a new apartment, causing Nathan and Debbie to race each other to find her a place that is the farthest away from each of them.

programme.title: The Millers: CON-Troversy
programme.desc: Nathan is assigned to cover a Sci-Fi Fest for his workplace and runs into a famous book author who has hated him since grade school.

programme.title: The Millers: Reunited and It Feels So Bad
programme.desc: Tom and Carol decide to formally end their marriage but are surprised when they both hesitate to finalize the divorce, sending Nathan and Debbie into a panic at the thought of their parents reconciling.
programme.sub-title: Reunited and It Feels So Bad

programme.title: The Millers: Give Metta World Peace a Chance
programme.desc: Nathan lands the biggest interview of his career with professional basketball player Metta World Peace, but when karma catches up with him, he risks ruining his professional reputation.
programme.sub-title: Give Metta World Peace a Chance

programme.title: The Millers: Diggin' Up Bones
programme.desc: In an attempt to get Carol to be more daring, Kip encourages her to confront her old Central Elementary School work nemesis, Miss Pam (Molly Shannon), at the teacher's retirement party.

programme.title: The Millers: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man
programme.desc: When Ray points out that Nathan has a history of being the worst wingman ever, Nathan embarks on a mission to be a better friend by becoming less self-involved.
programme.sub-title: You Are the Wind Beneath My Wings, Man

programme.title: The Millers: When The Pope Comes Marching In
programme.desc: When the Pope is scheduled to come to town, Nathan's planned week-long series of reports hits a snag when Ray gets a job offer to become the cameraman for a rival field reporter.
programme.sub-title: When The Pope Comes Marching In

programme.title: The Millers: Papa Was a Rolling Bone
programme.desc: The Millers decide to spend Thanksgiving apart for the first time ever, but they rethink the new family tradition when all their individual Turkey Day plans hit unexpected snags.

programme.title: The Millers: Louise Louise
programme.desc: When The Millers get a visit from their elderly Aunt Louise (Cloris Leachman), they rally to help her figure out what her legacy will be when she worries that she hasn't left her mark on the world yet.

programme.title: The Millers: Highway to the Manger Zone
programme.desc: When staging their church's annual living nativity scene does not go as planned, Kip urges the Millers to stage their own rival show.

programme.title: The Millers: Hero
programme.desc: When Nathan decides he should have a better relationship with his niece Mikayla, he agrees to use his celebrity status to help Debbie and Adam get her into a popular school.

programme.title: The Millers: Pilot
programme.desc: Nathan and his sister, Debbie, are upset when their parents announce they're divorcing after 43 years of marriage.

programme.title: The Millers: Stuff
programme.desc: Nathan hatches a plan to get his parents back together by showing them all of their sentimental family possessions in the hopes it will make them remember the good times they've had.

programme.title: The Millers: The Phone Upgrade
programme.desc: Nathan and Debbie trade parents when they each think the other sibling has it easier.

programme.title: The Millers: Plot Twists
programme.desc: When Carol dictates that it's time to rearrange the family's positions in the Millers cemetery plot because of the two divorces.

programme.title: The Millers: The Mother Is In
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Nathan is seeing a therapist, she secretly makes an appointment for herself in order to find out what's going on.

programme.title: The Millers: Giving The Bird
programme.desc: It's Halloween, and Nathan, Debbie, and Adam take Mikayla trick-or-treating to the house of an old woman who everyone in the neighborhood thinks is a witch.

programme.title: The Millers: Driving Miss Crazy
programme.desc: When Nathan gets frustrated after he's forced to drive Carol around town for errands once again, he demands that she either learn how to drive or find another chauffeur.

programme.title: The Millers: Internet Dating
programme.desc: When Nathan helps Carol set up her profile on an Internet dating site, he and Ray get so excited about one of her potential suitors, they start corresponding with him, pretending to be Carol.

programme.title: The Millers: You're In Trouble
programme.desc: When Nathan learns why Debbie is Tom's favorite child instead of him, he decides it's time to fill his parents in on some of Debbie's childhood secrets.

programme.title: The Millers: The Talk
programme.desc: When Carol finds out that Tom never had "the talk" with Nathan about the birds and the bees, she insists it's not too late to gather the family together and do it now.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town
programme.desc: When Carol's overbearing mother and father announce they're coming to visit for Christmas, Carol recruits Nate and Tom to cover up their failed relationships and present a happy facade.
programme.sub-title: Carol's Parents Are Coming to Town

programme.title: The Millers: Dear Diary
programme.desc: When Debbie suspects Nathan and Carol of secretly reading her diary, she and Adam plant a fake entry about Tom in order to prove it. Ernie Hudson guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: Miller's Mind
programme.desc: Nathan learns to appreciate Carol's incessant rants after he mimics one of them at work and is rewarded with his own news segment to complain on the air.

programme.title: The Millers: Carol's Surprise
programme.desc: Nathan is determined to finally, just once, surprise the "unsurpriseable" Carol on her birthday. Brandon Routh guest stars.

programme.title: The Millers: You Betcha
programme.desc: Nathan asks Tom to spend the weekend with him in the hopes of finding something they have in common.

programme.title: The Millers: Bahama Mama
programme.desc: Just as Nathan begins to unwind on his vacation in the Bahamas, Carol's surprise appearance gets him riled up all over again until they meet Ganja Pete.

programme.title: The Millers: Tomlandia
programme.desc: When Nathan pitches a children's show to his boss, Ed Dolan, based on Tom's imaginary comic book, Tom has an adverse reaction to the tweaks made to his cherished world. Jeffrey Tambor guest stars.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Crossover
programme.desc: A mishap in the wormhole sends Kira and Bashir into an alternate universe where Bajor is a tyrannical power and humans are slaves.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Second Skin
programme.desc: Kira is kidnapped by the Cardassians, who try to convince her that she is really one of their people.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Defiant
programme.desc: Wil Riker's renegade duplicate steals the Defiant and attacks Cardassian territory, forcing Sisko to assist Gul Dukat in stopping him.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Life Support
programme.desc: Bashir must use questionable methods in order to keep Vedek Bareil alive long enough to help bring about a Bajoran peace treaty with Cardassia.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Ties Of Blood And Water
programme.desc: The imminent death of Kira's Cardassian "father" rekindles painful memories of losing her real father

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Rocks And Shoals
programme.desc: Sisko and his crew are stranded on a remote planet with a dying Vorta and a small group of Jem'Hadar.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: His Way
programme.desc: Odo receives lessons in romancing Kira from a holographic 1960's lounge singer.

programme.title: Star Trek: Deep Space Nine: Shadows And Symbols
programme.desc: Sisko's quest to find a mythical Bajoran orb leads him to unlock the truth about his own existence.

programme.title: Star Trek: Voyager: Caretaker, del 1
programme.desc: När de söker en saknad officer, sveps kommendör Kathryn Janeway och besättningen på rymdkryssaren Voyager 70 000 ljusår hemifrån.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det vankas parceremoni och resan kommer att ta slut för en av gästerna. Stämningen är minst sagt hätsk efteråt och skriken ekar på hotellområdet. Pakterna i paradiset är tydligare än någonsin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Hotellet har förvandlats till en festival. Två artister checkar in, den ena lite mer välkänd än den andra... En av gästerna får det hett om öronen när han måste stå till svars för sina handlingar.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Att vinna tillbaka förlorad tillit är inte lätt, särskilt inte på Paradise Hotel. Kanske kan en blomma lätta upp stämningen?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det mytomspunna hotellet på Mexikos dramatiska västkust slår återigen upp portarna och det är ett taggat gäng som checkar in. Men, allt kan hända på Paradise Hotel och särskilt i händerna på JLC.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: JLC fortsätter styra premiärveckan med järnhand och redan andra dagen kommer tiden på hotellet vara över för några av gästerna. Starka känslor har etablerats mellan flera av deltagarna.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Känslorna fortsätter svalla på hotellet och spelet är i full gång. En tjej tvingas checka ut och planer smids inför den kommande parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Säsongens första parceremoni går till historien och efterspelet är inte nådigt. Allianser börja sakta men säkert luckras upp och hur pakterna kommer se ut framöver är högst oklart.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Ny vecka i Paradiset och frågan är om hotellet är en himmel eller ett helvete? Hemligheter avslöjas och två nya gäster checkar in för att röra om ordentligt i grytan.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av de nya gästerna visar sig ha ett förflutet med en av killarna, till hans partners stora förtret. Ett svek uppdagas som vänder upp och ner på hela hotellet.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skärselden fortsätter att locka fler offer och ett oväntat erbjudande dyker upp. Hur långt är man beredd att gå för att ta sig vidare? Dessutom har det blivit dags för säsongens första Pandoras Ask.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det uppdagas att flera på hotellet har blivit erbjudna samma sak, utan varandras vetskap, och stämningen blir minst sagt kylig. Parceremonin närmar sig, men innan dess ska en av tjejerna checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Parceremonin tvingar ytterligare en tjej att checka ut och frågan är, kan lojalitet leda till attraktion? Åtminstone verkar det fungera så på Paradise Hotel.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Skolveckan är i full gång och det vankas prov i ordkunskap. Kärlek blomstrar mellan ett par av eleverna och Frökens Favorit checkar in.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av eleverna tvingas checka ut när Frökens Favorit tar hans partner, och fler elever börjar känna kärleken spira. Skolans Värsting gör entré och det är ingen duvunge som kommer.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Vem målade Mona-Lisa? Och är Kuwait ett land eller en frukt? Nya prövningar väntar eleverna när en immunitet står på spel. Dessutom rör en dagsfest upp starka känslor – precis innan parceremonin.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En lojal partner är A och O på Paradise Hotel men, en back up är minst lika viktigt. Ytterligare en kille tvingas lämna hotellet och den efterföljande festen får svartsjuka att blossa upp.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Cirkusen har anlänt till Paradiset men, faror lurar i manegen. En galen mördarclown är lös på hotellet och när som helst kan någon bli mördad och tvingas checka ut.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Festen får svartsjukan att frodas och teorierna om vem som är hotellets mördarclown går isär. Två spådamer checkar in för att hjälpa till att lösa mysteriet men, vad är egentligen den röda tråden?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Pandoras Ask kommer aldrig lägligt men kanske extra olägligt just ikväll. En allians ”behind the scenes” blir allt starkare, men kommer spådamerna att lyssna på den alliansen eller inte?

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Det är aldrig kul när en annan tjej vill ha ens kille och speciellt inte på Paradise Hotel. Hemliga allianser riskerar att avslöjas när parceremonin tvingar alla att visa sina rätta färger.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Är det ostvecka på hotellet? Dags för lederhosen och dirndl när gästerna hamnat i Alperna. Ett välbekant ansikte checkar in, redo att ge allt och bara tänka på sig själv.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: En av killarna lägger näsan i… smink, och frågan är hur det kommer påverka spelet för hans del framöver. Ytterligare ett känt ansikte gör entré, redo att hämnas på sina motståndare.

programme.title: Paradise Hotel - Ny säsong!
programme.desc: Hotellets after ski bjuder på både bråk och kaos. Svartsjukan bubblar över för ett av paren och den stela stämningen sprider sig på hotellet.

programme.title: Andromeda: Frygt og afsky i Mælkevejen

programme.desc: Dylan og Rev Bem hjælper et fredeligt samfund med at stå op mod deres potentielle slavehandlere.

programme.title: Andromeda: Stjernekrydsede

programme.title: Andromeda: Endelig er tiden kommet
programme.desc: En gammel erindring fra Andromeda aktiveres ved et uheld, hvilket sender hende på en mission og efterlader Dylan og besætningen ude af stand til at tilsidesætte kommandoen

programme.title: Andromeda: Det voksende kredsløb

programme.title: Andromeda: Et hjerte for falskhed indrammet

programme.title: Andromeda: Ubarmhjertig som solen

programme.title: Andromeda: Ind i labyrinten

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Faldne Fødselsdagspige.

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Lidt for God Spiller

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry Menneskebæst

programme.title: Henry Danger: Usynlige Brad
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mands ven Brad, der ved et uheld for flere år siden blev usynlig, kommer på besøg. Der går ikke længe før alle er blevet trætte af ham.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Afsløreren
programme.desc: Henry og Ray forsøger at stoppe en yderst irriterende forbryder, der kalder sig for Afsløreren. Piper når grænsen, i forsøget på at komme med i en utroligt populær Kaptajn Mand fanklub.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Præmietyveri
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand får Henry med i hans yndlings gameshow, Spin og Vind, i forsøget på at nå til bunds i en række forbrydelser. Men Henry ender med selv at blive offer for den samme slags forbrydelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Supervulkanen
programme.desc: Da en supervulkan under Swellview ser ud til at kunne gå i udbrud, bliver Henry og Ray overbeviste om, at Verden snart går under. Piper er overbevist om at hun har glutenallergi.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Vold & Valentinsdag
programme.desc: Da pigen Henry er vild med, tager på date med en anden fyr på Valentinsdag, bygger Schwoz en androide, der kan hjælpe Henry med at gøre pigen jaloux. Ray tager på en ubehagelig date med en af Henrys lærere.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fanget i Kælderen
programme.desc: Henry, Charlotte og Rays sjove planer bliver aflyst, da Jasper kommer til at aktivere nød-nedlukningen i Skidt og Kanel.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Elevatorkysset
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen redder Bianca ender de med at kysse. Henry har det fint med det, indtil han indser at Bianca kyssede Faredrengen - og ikke Henry. Det mener Henry er det samme som at have været ham utro.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Manden i huset
programme.desc: Da Henrys mor får sin pung stjålet, beslutter Kaptajn Mand sig for at flytte hjem til Henrys familie, for at beskytte dem. Men Kaptajn Mand tager rollen som manden i huset lidt for alvorligt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Drømmefangerne
programme.desc: En skurks drømmestråle rammer Henry og spærrer ham inde i en drømmetilstand, som kun Charlotte kan redde ham ud fra.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Superhelt i Stuearrest
programme.desc: Da Henry bliver taget i at snige sig ud om aftenen, får han stuearrest. Charlotte overtager hans rolle som Kaptajn Mands makker og Piper gør hvad hun kan for at drive Henry til vanvid hjemme i huset.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Klovn
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand forsøger at forbedre sit omdømme, ved at afholde en konkurrence, hvor man kan vinde en rundvisning af den hemmelige hule. Da vinderne bliver nogle af Henrys venner, bliver han bekymret for om hans identitet kan blive afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Spandefælden
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte vil gerne fortælle Jasper, at Henry i virkeligheden er Faredrengen. De beslutter sig derfor for, at finde ud af om Jasper er klar til at få det at vide.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1
programme.desc: En gruppe grafittimalere overdænger Swellview med grafittitegninger. Og imens de forsøger at finde gruppens leder, bliver Faredrengen fristet af en sød pige i gruppen, der tvinger ham til at vælge imellem pigen og Kaptajn Mand.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, del 1

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2
programme.desc: Faredrengen er gået med i grafittibanden, der spraymaler overalt i Swellview. Kaptajn Mand forsøger desperat at finde Faredrengen og Van, der er leder af gruppen.
programme.sub-title: Henry og den Slemme Pige, Del 2

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jaspers Virkelige Kæreste
programme.desc: Jaspers kæreste fra sommerlejren er kommet for at besøge ham, og hun bor hos Charlotte. Men kæresten bliver jaloux, og tror at Charlotte er forelsket i Jasper.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Rytmerne Fortsætter
programme.desc: Da Dr. Minyak vender tilbage, er Henry pludselig i fare, da den ondskabsfulde doktor har lavet hans bedste ven Charlotte om til en super stærk skabning, der skal fange Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del
programme.desc: Henry forsøger at fange Den Gale Bedste - en gammel bedstemor, der bliver ved med at terrorisere Kaptajn Mand i offentligheden. Det giver Henry udfordringer på både arbejds- og kærlighedsfronten.
programme.sub-title: Én Henry, tre Piger: Første del

programme.title: Henry Danger: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del
programme.desc: Henrys planer for Frikadelle-festen på Swellview Junior High School er komplicerede, da han bliver nødt til også at møde op som Faredrengen. Under festen sker der ting, der gør, at han må træffe en dramatisk beslutning.
programme.sub-title: En Henry, tre Piger: Anden Del

programme.title: Henry Danger: Henry og Sortspætterne
programme.desc: Da Pipers basketballtræner stopper, træder Henry til som træner for Pipers hold i stedet. Han forsøger at piske holdet i form, men møder udfordringer fra idrætskomitéen og deres utraditionelle regler.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Kaptajn Mand: på Ferie
programme.desc: Ray har givet Henry og Charlotte ansvar for Swellview, mens han er bortrejst i forbindelse med sin fætters bryllup. Der opstår problemer, da de skal klare tingene på egen hånd.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Den Hemmelige Bøf
programme.desc: Henry har fået en invitation til Swellviews mest eksklusive restaurant og beslutter at invitere hans chef, Ray, med. Men tingene blive mere komplicerede end han regnede med.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Misundelige Henry
programme.desc: Efter at Jasper bliver rost som byens helt, bliver Henry jaloux over, at det altid er Faredrengen der får al anerkendelsen, mens han ikke selv får noget som helst.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Julefaren
programme.desc: Kaptajn Mand må tilbringe julen i fængsel, da han er blevet arresteret for en mindre forbrydelse. Henry og Charlotte må hjælpe ham med at bevare julestemningen bag tremmer.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uforgængelige Henry - 1. del
programme.desc: Henry beslutter sig for at blive usårlig ligesom Kaptajn Mand. Men tingene går ikke lige, som Henry har planlagt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Uforgængelige Henry - 2. del
programme.desc: Henry beslutter sig for at blive usårlig ligesom Kaptajn Mand. Men tingene går ikke lige, som Henry har planlagt.

programme.title: Henry Danger: SMS, Løgne og Video
programme.desc: Da en video af Henry og Rays transformation til Faredrengen og Kaptajn Mand slipper ud, må Henry gå til ekstremer for at holde sin hemmelighed hemmelig.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Det Omvendte Univers
programme.desc: Henry og Charlotte transporteres under en storm til et parallelt univers, hvor Ray og Schwoz er onde og vil Piper til livs. Onde Ray og Onde Schwoz skal standses, og Henry og Charlotte skal tilbage til deres eget univers.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare og Torden
programme.desc: Under infiltration af et hemmeligt forbrydermøde, opdager Phoebe Thunderman, som hjælper Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen, at hendes bror Max er deltager i mødet!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Fare og Torden, Anden Del
programme.desc: Under infiltration af et hemmeligt forbrydermøde, opdager Phoebe Thunderman, som hjælper Kaptajn Mand og Faredrengen, at hendes bror Max er deltager i mødet!

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tvillinge-Henryer
programme.desc: Henry får en Schwoz-skabt androide til at deltage i familiemiddagen, så Henry selv kan tage til årets MMA-kamp med Charlotte og Ray.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Gravalvorligt
programme.desc: Ray begynder at opføre sig mærkeligt, og da Henry og Charlotte undersøger, hvad der er galt, får de sig en overraskelse.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Voldkopper
programme.desc: Piper får en mystisk sygdom, så Kaptajn Mand må rejse tilbage til 1700-tallet, for at finde den eneste kur.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Jeg Kender din Hemmelighed
programme.desc: Henry har fået en mystisk besked fra en, og er bekymret for om hans hemmelige identitet er blevet afsløret.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Tidsnarreren
programme.desc: Da Faredrengen og Kaptajn-mand kæmper mod tidsnarreren, ryger Faredrengen uheldigvis ind i hans tidsmaskine og gennemlever derefter den samme dag om og om igen.

programme.title: Henry Danger: Faren Begynder
programme.desc: Henry Hart er en almindelig dreng i ottende klasse, indtil han bliver håndlanger for superhelten Kaptajn Mand, hvilket han skal holde hemmeligt.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Strong Impressions
programme.desc: The wife of an Air Force officer was found dead in her bed with a plastic laundry bag near her face. Further investigation proved that the scene had been staged. Her death wasn't an accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Prints Among Thieves
programme.desc: The murder of an eccentric millionaire was not entirely unexpected; he flaunted his wealth and cared little for personal security. The evidence at the crime seemed to indicate robbery, but investigators wondered if there was something more.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Waste Mis-Management
programme.desc: Foul play is suspected when Fort Worth factory worker Glenda Furch disappears after completing her shift.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Hear No Evil
programme.desc: In 2006, Darlene VanderGiesen received threatening emails and then disappeared. Tracking the source of the emails led police to the home of Daphne Wright, where they believe a murder was committed.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Material Witness
programme.desc: A teenager went missing after an evening of horseback riding. Her body was found a month later, three miles from her home. But the killer unknowingly left trace evidence behind.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Drowning Sorrows
programme.desc: A family vacation turns into a nightmare when a woman is found face-down in a lake.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Purebread Murder
programme.desc: In 2000, Christina Sanoubane was murdered in her Cedar Rapids apartment after moving away from her abusive boyfriend. There are clues at the scene: bloody footprints and DNA from the victim's rape kit.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Needle in a Haystack
programme.desc: There was no clear reason for a young, healthy college student to be dead. But when the coroner discovered a tiny clue during the autopsy, investigators were able to uncover a mystery filled with betrayal and revenge.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Formula
programme.desc: When four-month-old Ryan Stallings dies under suspicious circumstances, his mother is ultimately convicted of his murder. But months later, new evidence emerges from a startling source — his newborn brother.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Who's Your Daddy
programme.desc: In 1988, the body of a young woman was discovered in an Ohio river. Most of the evidence had been washed away, but the victim's 6-year-old son unwittingly told investigators all they needed to know — without saying a word. The clue was in his genes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seeds for Doubt
programme.desc: In 2002, a small community in upstate New York was devastated when Patty Wlasiuk died in a truck accident. But burdock seed pods found in her hair and on her clothes indicated that this was no accident — it was cold-blooded murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Photo Finish
programme.desc: Professional photographer Charles Rathbun claims model Linda Sobek died during a consensual sexual encounter gone wrong, but Sobek's corpse and digital imaging tell a more sinister story.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Pinned by the Evidence
programme.desc: After a street fight takes the life of a national wrestling champion, police must determine if he was killed in cold blood or in self-defense.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Brotherhoods
programme.desc: Two men are murdered while sleeping in their beds. The next night, arson destroys a family planning clinic. Investigators wonder whether some shards of glass, paint chips and a chicken feather could link what appear to be two separate crimes.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Paintball
programme.desc: In 1962, the small town residents of Hanford, California lost their sense of peace when one of their own, 15-year-old Marlene Miller, was murdered.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Home of the Brave
programme.desc: In 2007, the Florida mobile home of Effie and Michael Ratley catches fire. Michael heroically rescues his wife and infant son. A month later, his wife is found beaten to death in a bedroom of his parents' home.

programme.title: Forensic Files: A Leg to Stand On
programme.desc: The police investigate when a severed leg is discovered among garbage. Conventional means of identifying the victim are impossible, leading investigators to rely on DNA, forensic anthropology and toxicology.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Knowledge
programme.desc: Police investigate a missing college girl and discover her double life: attending school by day and working as a call-girl by night. Her body is found and investigators find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Once Bitten
programme.desc: Investigators find a shoe print, several foreign hairs and unknown fingerprints at a murder scene. But they believe the most telling piece of evidence is the bite mark on the victim's chest.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Whodunit
programme.desc: In 1998, a Maryland murder mystery performance turns into a real whodunit when the badly burned body of Stephen Hricko is discovered in his hotel room.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Seedy Intentions
programme.desc: When a 9-year-old girl goes missing, police and volunteers spend weeks searching for her. A psychic's vision leads to a field where her body is discovered, along with what investigators hope is enough evidence to find her killer.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Deadly Rebellion
programme.desc: Even though their daughter had run away before, she had always come back. Her parents were sure this time would be no different, but they were wrong.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Slippery Motives
programme.desc: Edward Post drew a bath for his wife before going for a run. He returned to find her not breathing. She died before emergency response arrived. Police considered her death accidental until a motive surfaced.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Low Maintenance
programme.desc: In 2008, college co-ed Jenna Verhaalen was found dead in her Bryan, Texas apartment. Petechial hemorrhages in her eyes indicated that she was strangled.

programme.title: Forensic Files: South of the Border
programme.desc: The murder of an American tourist in a Mexican resort draws law enforcement resources on both sides of the border. At first glance, the motive appears to be robbery, but careful analysis of the forensic evidence points to something more sinister.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Saving Face
programme.desc: When a woman disappeared without a trace, there were two possible explanations: kidnapping or murder. Careful investigation, a forensic artist and DNA profiling enabled police to find a single suspect, who was known to prey upon vulnerable women.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Stick 'Em Up
programme.desc: Residents of Noel, Missouri were stunned to learn that their bank had been robbed and the bank president was missing. His body was later found floating in a lake, securely bound to a chair with duct tape.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Fresh Heir
programme.desc: Lives changed in the 20 years following an unsolved murder, and so did forensic science. In time, a high-powered microscope and DNA profiling revealed a clue no one had seen before.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Last Will
programme.desc: Authorities track a kidnapper who let his victim write a last will and informed the family of her murder. A phone number written on a previous page left a lasting impression, which helped to convict.

programme.title: Forensic Files: House Hunting
programme.desc: In 2006, Texas real estate agent Sarah Anne Walker was found brutally murdered in a model home. Weeks later, a witness came forward who may have seen the killer. Police used forensic hypnosis to help him recall every detail of the man's appearance.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Head Games
programme.desc: A young couple decided to celebrate their first wedding anniversary with a camping trip to Mount Hood. During the trip, the husband was shot and killed. Later, his wife told two different versions of the events which led to his death.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Reel Dangerq
programme.desc: When two boys are brutally attacked, investigators rely on evidence fished out of a nearby pond. It became the first case where diatom analysis was used to place a suspect at the scene of the crime.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shadow of a Doubt
programme.desc: A woman is shot to death in her store just one day before she is to testify against the man accused of robbing her. The robber becomes the prime suspect, but he has a solid alibi: a timestamped videotape of his activities on the day of the murder.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Speck of Evidence
programme.desc: On September 17, 1984, in a suburb of Tucson, Arizona, eight-year-old Vicki Hoskins left home on her pink bicycle to mail a letter for her mother. She never returned, but her slightly damaged bicycle was found nearby.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Dog Day Afternoon
programme.desc: A woman was brutally murdered in her home and the only witnesses to the crime were the family dogs. An expert in canine behavior was convinced the killer knew both the victim and the animals, and he was determined find out what the dogs had seen.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Shot of Vengeance
programme.desc: A 34-year-old nurse experiences a variety of flu-like symptoms. None of her doctors are able to discover the cause, until she visits her gynecologist for a routine check-up.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Insect Clues
programme.desc: Between 1985 and 1988, 18 people were choked, molested and left for dead in the remote mountains of California. The only witnesses were the insects — and they play an important role in solving the crimes and bringing the killer to justice.

programme.title: Forensic Files: Beaten by a Hair
programme.desc: In 1992, Laura Houghteling disappeared from her Bethesda home and was never seen again. Forensic scientists use evidence from her bedroom to direct police to a prime suspect.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Above the Law
programme.desc: California Highway Patrolman George Gwaltney discovered the body of 23-year-old Robin Bishop near her car on a remote desert highway.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Shattered Shield
programme.desc: In a city awash in narcotics the drug lords have all the power even over the police. Corruption in New Orleans grew like cancer, eating away at public safety and threatening to destroy the city. Crooked cops break the laws they were sworn to uphold.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Model Killer
programme.desc: It's a model's job to rivet the public's attention. But in 1984, some aspiring models began attracting publicity in a terrible new way.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Dead Run
programme.desc: In Pennsylvania, an inmate escaped with the help of his female accomplice. Following a trail of fraudulent credit card receipts and deaths, authorities track the pair, but always find themselves one step behind.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: A kidnapping can shatter a family, bringing terror and heartache without warning. In 1984 with the flash of a gun, an ordinary business transaction became a violent abduction. In seconds, the son of a wealthy Miami developer was gone.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the 1990s, neighborhoods in Detroit were terrorized by a gang of robbers. Impersonating police officers, they invaded over 100 homes robbing, raping and torturing their victims.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Small Town Terror
programme.desc: In a small Ohio community, an elderly woman and a teenaged boy disappeared. Because they vanished within hours of each other, police believed the cases were linked. But they didn't know how.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the late 70s and early 80s, a legitimate Puerto Rican independence movement took hold in the United States. But a splinter terrorist group known as the FALN was suspected of executing hundreds of bombings in major US cities.

programme.title: The FBI Files: A Family Torn
programme.desc: The parents of 11 yr. old Brittany Martinez knew their daughter was no runaway. Something had happened to her, something terrible. When they failed to find Brittany in their quiet Illinois neighborhood, they called the police.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: When the victim of a violent crime is a member of law enforcement, the job of investigating becomes personal. At a United States border crossing, armed fugitives kidnapped a customs' inspector then vanished.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Trail
programme.desc: The disappearance of young women triggered a search that spanned the Pacific Northwest. A massive media campaign failed to locate the drifter, who first charmed then killed them. As investigators followed his trail, he always stayed one step ahead.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Master Plan
programme.desc: Willow Springs, Illinois, seemed like any other quiet Midwestern community. But it was really one of the most corrupt places in the nation. This tiny village, nestled just outside of Chicago, was in the hip pocket of organized crime.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Lost Boys
programme.desc: In June of 1997, a crime wave swept Iowa like a tornado. It left a trail of robbery, kidnapping, and murder in its wake, and then it moved on. No one knew where.

programme.title: The FBI Files
programme.desc: In the United States, identity theft costs citizens billions of dollars. In some cases, it costs the lives of innocent people.

programme.title: The FBI Files: Without Mercy
programme.desc: Despite what you see in the movies, most bank robbers come in quietly, pass a note, and slip away. They want cash, not bloodshed. But in Richmond, Virginia, a pair of gunmen entered a bank with their guns blazing.

programme.title: The FBI Files: The Crazy Don
programme.desc: To the FBI, he was believed to be the boss of New York's most powerful mafia organizationthe Genovese crime family. Was Gigante crazy or was his behavior a shrewd attempt to disguise his position as a ruthless mafia boss?

programme.title: The FBI Files: Deadly Stranger
programme.desc: The body of a young woman found burned in a truck launched a manhunt to find her killer. When more bodies began to turn up across the country, the FBI believed the cases were linked. Investigators had a suspect. They just couldn't find him.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Left At The Scene
programme.desc: The tiniest residue left at the scene can become a mark of distinction in the most singular and intimate of ways.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Invisible Death
programme.desc: Poison is an almost invisible form of death, and toxicologists must look for hidden clues in blood and tissue to bring these murders to light.

programme.title: The New Detectives: To Kill Again
programme.desc: Some people do get away with murder at least for a while. Flush with their success, serial killers murder again and again. But each time they kill, they leave behind a few more clues, which ultimately lead to their capture.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Written In Bone
programme.desc: At the scene of a murder, sometimes the victim provides the only clues to their killer. Forensic anthropologists use skeletal remains to decipher the clues written in the bones.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Cold Blooded
programme.desc: Time of death is an important consideration in a murder investigation, but when a killer freezes, burns, or grinds his victim, even the most skilled medical examiner would be at a loss about how to calculate it.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Fatal Error
programme.desc: Accidental deaths, suicides, disappearances, and fires; they're an everyday part of an insurance investigator's life. But cases shouldn't be taken at face value. Forensics has become a tool for exposing insurance fraud.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Dead In The Water
programme.desc: Drowning deaths often look like accidents and water can destroy the scant clues the killer may have left behind. Investigators must turn to forensic science to solve cases where the victim is found dead in the water.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Scent Of The Kill
programme.desc: A dog can be a dead man's best friend. Dogs have been trained to sniff out corpses, drugs, explosives, and missing persons. They're often the first to find the essential clue that sets an investigation in motion.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Bloodlust
programme.desc: For homicide investigators, it's a race against time as they track their deadliest foe: a serial killer for whom killing is the only way to feel alive.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly Aim
programme.desc: Ballistic analysis is the key to finding killers who turn guns on their victims. Each shot fired leaves its own "fingerprint", allowing scientists to target murderers with deadly aim.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Stolen Identity
programme.desc: When a theft is committed, something valuable is stolen. But when a criminal needs a new identity, theft becomes a matter of life and death.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Silent Witness
programme.desc: Three hairs, microscopic fibers, a common trash bag ripped from a roll. Seemingly small and insignificant clues become a victim's silent witness.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Deadly intentions
programme.desc: When abduction turns to murder, forensic science is the only key to finding justice for the victims of a kidnapper's deadly intentions.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Patterns Of Guilt
programme.desc: The tread of a tire, a single shoe print and even the shape of a bruise help investigators track down killers, based solely on their patterns of guilt.

programme.title: The New Detectives: A Deadly Smile
programme.desc: Investigators rely on forensic odontology to identify a body from a single tooth and to catch two brutal killers from their bite marks.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Military Justice
programme.desc: The Naval Criminal Investigative Service uses forensic science to solve three perplexing murders and fulfill their motto: "To the living we owe respect; to the dead, we owe the truth."

programme.title: The New Detectives: The Unforgotten
programme.desc: Years after a murder has been committed, investigators use advanced DNA analysis to shed new light on crimes that have gone unpunished for far too long.

programme.title: The New Detectives: Buried Secrets
programme.desc: Forensic scientists find clues written in blood as they investigate the deaths of three women killed by the men who once loved them.

programme.desc: Lauren får en god nyhed til Teen Vogue og Heidi har brug for noget tid væk fra Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: Paris Changes Everything
programme.desc: Lauren kommer endelig af sted til Paris, men turen bliver næsten ødelagt da hun finder ud af, at Brody har fundet en anden. Spencer følger Heidi til Colorado for at prøve at vinde hende tilbage, men hans plan slår fejl.

programme.title: The Hills: Back to L.A.
programme.desc: Whitney må vælge mellem Teen Vogue og risikoen forbundet med at gå efter en ny karriere. Lauren og Brody skændes over hans nye kæreste og Heidi vænner sig til livet uden Spencer.

programme.title: The Hills: An Unexpected Friend
programme.desc: Lauren får en uventet ven, da Spencers søster, Stephanie, går til de samme timer som hende. Whitney tror, at hendes nye job vil opfylde alle hendes drømme.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Aftenstranden
programme.desc: Kan Lockie og Yaz finde ud af at bo sammen? Chloe lægger alle sine æg i en kurv og en djævelsk flot kendis ryster villaen, men hvem ryger hjem nu?

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Den eneste vej er eks
programme.desc: To ekser bliver elimineret, og James bliver knust. Yaz og Lockie prøver en sidste gang at slutte fred. En kendiseks laver ravage og villaen siger farvel til en OG.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Historien gentager sig
programme.desc: Jarred er frustreret og oprørt, Tamara føler, at historien kan gentage sig og Callum slår til.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Hænger i en tynd tråd
programme.desc: En ny kendis truer med at spolere et allerede skrøbeligt parforhold. Tamara kommer videre fra Joe og Paige er i et trekantsdrame mellem gammel og ny.

programme.title: Celebrity Ex on the Beach: Flamme-ceremoni
programme.desc: Der er en chokeliminering, som ryster villaen. Paige må tage en kæmpestor beslutning, og den sidste aften bliver en tåreperser for kendisserne i en flammende ceremoni.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US
programme.desc: 10 stjerner fra reality-tv og sociale medier tror, at de er på en sexet tropeferie, men paradiset forvandles til et mareridt, når deres ekser dukker op på stranden. Vil det tænde gamle flammer eller åbne gamle sår?

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Being Shady 101
programme.desc: Den 10. single ankommer til villaen og lander midt i en kærlighedstrekant. Farrah provokerer sine bofæller. En eks spreder et ondt rygte, når sårede følelser giver sig udtryk i hævn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Simon Says
programme.desc: Farrah får en stor overraskelse i Hemmelighedshulen. En eks af en eks dukker op og laver ravage i et spirende forhold og afslører nogle løgne. Den første eks bliver sendt hjem.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Worst Date Ever
programme.desc: To ekser går ssammen for at vælte Maya og hendes slæng. En uventet overraskelse bringer et af husets stærkeste par i fare.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Jay Is For Jealous
programme.desc: Huset fejrer Farrahs tilbagevenden. Jalousi starter en fysisk konfrontation, da en intim sandhed bliver afsløret. Noget uventet sker ved eliminering.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Low Blows
programme.desc: En forventet eks-ankomst starter et ordentligt skænderi, da ulmende spændinger omsider eksploderer. Farrah blander sig i andres sager og gør huset mere kaotisk.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Revenge is Sweet
programme.desc: Handlinger har konsekvenser, da ekserne hører om de slemme ting, som singlerne har sagt om dem. Jays usikkerhed om Morgans ekser når kogepunktet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Here Comes Trouble
programme.desc: Et ustabilt forhold bliver turbulent da Angela vender tilbage til stranden for at lave ravage og stjæle nogle mænd. Huset flipper ud, da en fest kører af sporet.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Un-Bear-Able
programme.desc: Sandheden om Murrays skumle fortid bliver blotlagt. Det stærkeste par i huset konfronterer sit første eks-problem. Janelle lærer konsekvenserne af sine handlinger.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: How to Keep a Man 101
programme.desc: Chad og Nicoles situation forværres da endnu en eks ankommer. En fest i huset får endnu en deltager til at bryde sammen i jalousi.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ghost of Relationship's Past
programme.desc: Nicoles jalousi får frit afløb da Maddie siger nogle urimelige ting.Et fortidsspøgelse dukker op for at søge hævn.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Bad Bromance
programme.desc: Angelas værste mareridt går i opfyldelse da en eks dukker op på stranden. Chad skal forholde sig til konsekvenserne af Nicoles handlinger. Et skænderi truer med at afslutte den største bromance i huset.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex-Viction Notice
programme.desc: Hemmelighedshullet slår til, da Angela bliver sat i den varme stol, og Nurys skal træffe en vigtig beslutning. Ekserne mødes med en overraskende eliminering.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Ex, Lies, and Polygraph Tape
programme.desc: Farrah vender tilbage for at finde ud af, om hun er kommet sig helt over sin eks. Sandheden afsløres, da alle i huset tvinges til at evaluere deres forhold baseret på en løgnedetektortest.

programme.title: Ex On The Beach US: Reunion Part 1
programme.desc: Efter en turbulent sæson genforenes singlerne og ekserne for første gang for at tale om sæsonens største forhold, splittelser og forræderi. De afslører, om de stadig er forelskede eller er gået fra hinanden siden sæsonen sluttede.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Krissys Volkswagen Baja Bug. Med et slidt udstædningsrør og smadrede døre er hendes bil langt fra i tiptop stand.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride
programme.desc: I dette afsnit pimper teamet Brians Honda CRX. Det er den første bil, der får en ny motor fordi den gamle motor dør før Xzibit kan få bilen hen på værkstedet.

programme.title: Pimp My Ride

programme.title: Are You The One?: White Party
programme.desc: Til hvid fest har alle i huset det sjovt, men John må forholde sig til Jacys følelser for Scali. I en udfordring på stranden får parrene sand under neglene.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Rub Down With A Happy Ending
programme.desc: Huset forsøger at regne ud, hvordan de finder deres perfekte match og vinder en million dollars. Jacy ser sine følelser for Scali og John i øjnene, da huset forsøger at løse den sidste kærlighedstrekant.
programme.sub-title: Rub Down With A Happy Ending

programme.title: Are You The One?: Reunion Special
programme.desc: Alle de tyve deltagere bliver genforenet med Ryan Devlin for at diskutere, hvad der skete på Hawaii, og vi viser ikke tidligere vist materiale, chokerende afsløringer og sladder om parrene som fortsat er sammen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Are You The One? Special Delivery
programme.desc: Deltagerne i første sæson genforenes til den største begivenhed i Ethans og Ambers liv - en baby! Find ud af, hvordan det er gået med deltagerne, mens de tilbringer en vild weekend sammen for at fejre babyen med et AYTO-gave.
programme.sub-title: Are You The One? Special Delivery

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Too Many
programme.desc: 10 perfekt sammensatte fyre og piger får et chok, når de finder ud af, det bliver sværere at finde 10 par, for der er 11 piger. Paris og Pratt prøver at undgå den første sandhedsbås.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Truth Will Cost You
programme.desc: Teamet bliver spændt, da både Layton og Shelby havner i kærlighedstrekanter. Fyrene graver ting op om pigerne i en konkurrence, som kan sende den ellevte pige i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Virgin Tears
programme.desc: Der er tårer, da Shelby afslutter sin kærlighedstrekant. John prøver at nærme sig Christina, men bliver blokeret af Brandon, hendes ikke-match. Teamet bliver chokeret da de hører, at der er en jomfru blandt dem.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Loose Lips Sink Relationships
programme.desc: En fuld kikser kan splitte det stærkeste par i huset. Anthony bager heftigt på Laytons forelskelse, Jenni. John prøver endelig lykken med Christina. Parceremonien gør huset helt rundt på gulvet.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Strap Those Boots Tight
programme.desc: Huset er chokeret efter sidste parceremoni. Jenni mener, at Layton er hendes rette fyr, men frygter at en knust Jessica bliver vred. For et par truer sandhedsbåsen med at bringe mere hjertesorg.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Parental Guidance
programme.desc: Pigerne får overraskende informationer, når deres forældre kommer for at udspørge fyrene. Når forældrene rejser, eksploderer spændingerne mellem Layton og Anthony. Huset finder ud af, at historien kan gentage sig.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Hot Salsa
programme.desc: Efter en mislykket parceremoni er huset klar til en ny start. John mener endelig at have fundet den rette i Jenni, men de andre i huset er ikke så sikre. Ashley befinder sig i et potentielt eksplosivt trekantsdrama.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Dumped
programme.desc: Kampen mellem Dario og Layton over Ashley strammer til. Ellie vender sin opmærksomhed mod Nathan, som er overbevist om, at Christina er hans perfekte partner. For Christina bliver presset med at være pige nummer 11 for meget.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Old Flames
programme.desc: Selvom de ikke er et par, eksploderer Nathan, når Christina går tilbage til Brandon. Med to parceremonier tilbage, kunne Ashleys ubeslutsomhed mellem Layton og Dario afholde huset fra at vinde det hele.

programme.title: Are You The One?: One Switch, One Glitch
programme.desc: Det er den sidste parceremoni og de skal udskifte et par. Mens sandhedsbåsen giver et tiltrængt svar, bringer spørgsmålet om pige nummer 11 millionen i fare.

programme.title: Are You The One?: The Season Aftermatch
programme.desc: Hele sæsonens hemmeligheder, drama og uafklarede affærer kommer frem i lyset i dette genforeningsafsnit, hvor de medvirkende skiftes til at sidde i den varme stol.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Perfect Match at First Sight
programme.desc: 20 singler ankommer til Hawaii for at finde kærlighed og vinde 1 million dollar. Deres kærlighed ved første blik-instinkter bliver sat på prøve med 250.000 ekstra på spil. En kærlighedstrekant fører til en pinlig parceremoni.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Punch Drunk Love
programme.desc: John eksploderer, når forholdet til Julia forandrer sig. Asaf og Francesca ved ikke, hvor de står, da en tur til bolleværelset kikser. Kaylen slipper en bombe om sit forhold til Gio, som chokerer huset.

programme.title: Are You The One?: She Don't Want You
programme.desc: John flipper skråt, da Stephen bager på Julia. Tori og Camille er begge ude efter den samme fyr. Presset er stort for de 'gyldne par' som skal i sandhedsbåsen.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Three's a Crowd
programme.desc: Huset er i oprør, da Gio og Kaylens perfekte forhold begynder at slå revner. Asaf går i seng med den forkerte person.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Beer Goggles
programme.desc: Forholdet mellem Gio og Kaylen får alle op på dupperne, da Gio bager på Julia og alle andre piger i huset. Cam og Victoria har en nat, der ikke er værd at huske.

programme.title: Are You The One?: Mammas' Boys
programme.desc: Fyrene viser deres bløde siger, når deres mødre afslører pinlige detaljer. Stephen bliver ekstremt paranoid på grund af Gios intresse for Julia. Francesca bliver fanget i Gios klør.
